dedupe_keys.name: seznam avtobusnih postajalisc v obcini sentjernej

description: Seznam avtobusnih postajališč v Občini Šentjernej is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. List of bus stops in Šentjernej Municipality. The collection contains the name and location coordinates of the stops. Coverage: OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. The portal shows the English title as "List of bus stops in Šentjernej" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. Its keywords include avtobusna postajališča. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
